name: flow-reducer-closure
description: Lockfile-bearing manifest for the audited Flow reducer closure (#1054). @kontourai/flow is version-pinned but its transitive dependencies are caret ranges, so a lockfile-free install floats them and invalidates the pinned closure digest whenever anything upstream publishes. The lifecycle-authority eval COPIES these two files to a temp dir and runs `npm ci` there, so the staged closure is byte-identical everywhere. DO NOT run npm inside this directory: npm walks up, treats the repository root as the project, and empties the root node_modules. To regenerate the lock, copy both files to a temp dir, run `npm install --package-lock-only` there, and copy package-lock.json back.
